# VEUX P5: source-only semantics, no KernelSU/SUSFS/NoMount/BR eNE changes.
# Data: pinned R4 / P3 / P4 artifacts; upstream SUSFS 5.10 patch blobs.
# SUCCESS means audit ran and non-equivalence risks are documented; NOT a final-build or device PASS.
name: VEUX SUSFS 5.4 P5 SELinux Functional Source Audit - NO BUILD

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: veux-susfs54-p5-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
  GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: '0'
  EXPECTED_REPO: Chrizz100/veux-nongki-universal-kernel
  P5_WORK: /tmp/veux-susfs54-p5-${{ github.run_id }}
  SUSFS_510_PIN: c1a8ccbb36f8e7d2cf9c28194fa8f2745dc767c1

jobs:
  p5_source_audit:
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'Chrizz100/veux-nongki-universal-kernel' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    name: P5 read-only SELinux behavior comparison - no kernel build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact commit without stored credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify repository and exact green R4 overlay (no write)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" != "$EXPECTED_REPO" ]; then exit 1; fi
          if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]; then exit 1; fi
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" ]; then exit 1; fi
          printf '%s  %s\n' '8deeb75bdd09df49e48f384009268de03eb18555606a27f88074a2375195ade9' \
            "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/VEUX_NOMOUNT_DEV_8175_R4_MAIN.zip" | sha256sum --check --status
          mkdir -p "$P5_WORK/reports" "$P5_WORK/archives" "$P5_WORK/upstream" "$P5_WORK/checks" "$P5_WORK/fixtures"
          echo 'P5_REPO_AND_R4_MAIN_PIN=PASS'
      - name: Self-verify YAML with pinned actionlint and ShellCheck
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          f="$P5_WORK/actionlint_1.7.12_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          curl -fLSsS --retry 3 --max-time 120 \
            'https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v1.7.12/actionlint_1.7.12_linux_amd64.tar.gz' -o "$f"
          printf '%s  %s\n' '8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8' "$f" | sha256sum --check --status
          tar -xzf "$f" -C "$P5_WORK/checks" actionlint
          if ! command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sudo apt-get update -qq
            sudo apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends shellcheck
          fi
          command -v shellcheck
          "$P5_WORK/checks/actionlint" -oneline .github/workflows/VEUX_SUSFS54_P5_FUNCTIONAL_SOURCE_AUDIT_NO_BUILD.yml
          echo 'P5_ACTIONLINT_SHELLCHECK=PASS'
      - name: Authenticate pinned R4 P3 P4 artifact metadata
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY_P5_AUTH'
          import json,os,urllib.request
          from pathlib import Path
          expected={
              12167285024:('VEUX-R5S2-NMDEV8175-BAKASU35234-AUDIT-39207040902',39207040902,'73a8c2d9b9be945ea1c2a7f6893c8fb9c8c2d122','sha256:f81f4f47e7c61ea87bee3ecf6e400476f5ffe7a77f9a872eed6e1f16b64080a8'),
              12173591932:('VEUX-SUSFS54-P3-R4-PREFLIGHT-SOURCE-39225149753',39225149753,'8915d0f97a6b88b76aef30732635c92ec762de7a','sha256:eacc332f5154b2708560b2dd00a16df3c3847c113535e2132ee9f31ea5f841f0'),
              12178300926:('VEUX-SUSFS54-P4-SOURCE-ONLY-39232161365',39232161365,'90638016d58743736e18290d0bb4c7ad5a318e72','sha256:695e692846d27a22c110746f02f82c3b13bcb2db30a12d682a82f0ec904d8cdd'),
          }
          result={}
          repo=os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']; token=os.environ['GH_TOKEN']
          for aid,(name,run,sha,digest) in expected.items():
              url=f'https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/actions/artifacts/{aid}'
              req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'User-Agent':'veux-susfs54-p5','X-GitHub-Api-Version':'2022-11-28'})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=40) as resp:
                  obj=json.load(resp)
              wr=obj.get('workflow_run') or {}
              if (obj.get('id')!=aid or obj.get('name')!=name or obj.get('expired') is not False or obj.get('digest')!=digest or wr.get('id')!=run or wr.get('head_sha')!=sha or wr.get('head_branch')!='main'):
                  raise SystemExit('P5_ARTIFACT_META_MISMATCH:'+str(aid))
              result[str(aid)]={'name':name,'run':run,'sha':sha,'digest':digest}
          out=Path(os.environ['P5_WORK'])/'reports/ARTIFACT_METADATA.json'
          out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
          print('P5_ARTIFACT_METADATA=PASS; PINNED=3')
          PY_P5_AUTH
      - name: Download exact archived evidence and latest pinned SUSFS patch files
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          api='https://api.github.com/repos/Chrizz100/veux-nongki-universal-kernel/actions/artifacts'
          for pair in '12167285024:r4_audit' '12173591932:p3' '12178300926:p4'; do
            id="${pair%%:*}"
            name="${pair#*:}"
            curl -fLSsS --retry 3 --max-time 120 \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
              -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
              -H 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
              "$api/$id/zip" -o "$P5_WORK/archives/$name.zip"
          done
          printf '%s  %s\n' 'f81f4f47e7c61ea87bee3ecf6e400476f5ffe7a77f9a872eed6e1f16b64080a8' "$P5_WORK/archives/r4_audit.zip" | sha256sum --check --status
          printf '%s  %s\n' 'eacc332f5154b2708560b2dd00a16df3c3847c113535e2132ee9f31ea5f841f0' "$P5_WORK/archives/p3.zip" | sha256sum --check --status
          printf '%s  %s\n' '695e692846d27a22c110746f02f82c3b13bcb2db30a12d682a82f0ec904d8cdd' "$P5_WORK/archives/p4.zip" | sha256sum --check --status
          base="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ShirkNeko/susfs4ksu/$SUSFS_510_PIN/kernel_patches"
          curl -fLSsS --retry 3 --max-time 90 "$base/50_add_susfs_in_gki-android13-5.10.patch" -o "$P5_WORK/upstream/host.patch"
          curl -fLSsS --retry 3 --max-time 90 "$base/KernelSU/10_enable_susfs_for_ksu.patch" -o "$P5_WORK/upstream/ksu.patch"
          test "$(git hash-object "$P5_WORK/upstream/host.patch")" = '3bcfe2e098a07a271c90688eaf3217d58f850546'
          test "$(git hash-object "$P5_WORK/upstream/ksu.patch")" = 'b7a5278e38096c77cacb7bbdd988ae2987ab0dec'
          echo 'P5_ORIGINAL_ARTIFACTS_AND_SUSFS510_PATCHES_PINNED=PASS'
      - name: Create SHA-pinned P5 functional evaluator and 18 negative tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > "$P5_WORK/checks/p5_source_audit.py" <<'PY_P5_GATE'
          #!/usr/bin/env python3
          """VEUX SUSFS P5: read-only functional-source review (no compile or flash).

          Pinned sources: green R4 compiled BakaSU, P3 preflight 5.4 SELinux,
          P4 identity gate, and the 2026-10-18 SUSFS 5.10 *patch* references.
          This is NOT a runtime-equivalence proof or a patch applier.
          """
          import argparse
          import hashlib
          import json
          import re
          import sys
          import zipfile
          from pathlib import Path

          EXPECTED = {
              'p3_zip': 'eacc332f5154b2708560b2dd00a16df3c3847c113535e2132ee9f31ea5f841f0',
              'p4_zip': '695e692846d27a22c110746f02f82c3b13bcb2db30a12d682a82f0ec904d8cdd',
              'r4_audit_zip': 'f81f4f47e7c61ea87bee3ecf6e400476f5ffe7a77f9a872eed6e1f16b64080a8',
              'r4_main_zip': '8deeb75bdd09df49e48f384009268de03eb18555606a27f88074a2375195ade9',
              'r4_bakasu': '78231ad073f1437804cd6b340dfd7273f5d25591c43ebb69f443cabacdfa8b78',
              'p3_bakasu': 'e4299d4db52b3e761413928d733076dc497104cee0cd5ab27e165364cd773c5c',
              'p3_hooks': '57a84c1b0f41d108e9557314c0039e5bfd6fc4b15aa60532711d32e551cc2992',
              'p3_selinuxfs': '16533ae84611ddc908759231a06ac09722cbeda3cba7ebc361baa1ee462729a1',
              'p3_namespace': 'a5dd3990f0ebc3ac3442e387226ffd03b9a23a47ca648ec8646f710a1ab6ba4d',
              'susfs_host_git_blob': '3bcfe2e098a07a271c90688eaf3217d58f850546',
              'susfs_ksu_git_blob': 'b7a5278e38096c77cacb7bbdd988ae2987ab0dec',
          }
          R4 = '73a8c2d9b9be945ea1c2a7f6893c8fb9c8c2d122'
          P3 = '8915d0f97a6b88b76aef30732635c92ec762de7a'
          SUSFS510 = 'c1a8ccbb36f8e7d2cf9c28194fa8f2745dc767c1'


          class GateBlocked(RuntimeError):
              pass


          def require(predicate, reason):
              if not predicate:
                  raise GateBlocked(reason)


          def sha256(raw):
              return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


          def blob_sha1(raw):
              return hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode('ascii') + b'\x00' + raw).hexdigest()


          def read_file(path, expected, name):
              p = Path(path)
              require(p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(), name + '_MISSING_OR_SYMLINK')
              raw = p.read_bytes()
              require(sha256(raw) == expected, name + '_SHA256_MISMATCH')
              return raw


          def read_archive(path, expected, name):
              raw = read_file(path, expected, name)
              z = zipfile.ZipFile(Path(path))
              require(z.testzip() is None, name + '_ZIP_CRC_FAILED')
              require(len(z.namelist()) == len(set(z.namelist())), name + '_DUPLICATE_ENTRY')
              return z


          def take(z, name, digest=None):
              require(name in z.namelist(), 'ARCHIVE_MISSING:' + name)
              row = z.getinfo(name)
              require(not (row.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000 == 0o120000, 'ZIP_SYMLINK:' + name)
              raw = z.read(name)
              if digest is not None:
                  require(sha256(raw) == digest, 'SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH:' + name)
              return raw


          def load_json(raw, name):
              try:
                  return json.loads(raw)
              except (ValueError, UnicodeError, TypeError) as exc:
                  raise GateBlocked(name + '_JSON_INVALID') from exc


          def section(patch, file):
              name = 'diff --git a/' + file + ' b/' + file
              idx = patch.find(name)
              require(idx >= 0, 'UPSTREAM_SECTION_MISSING:' + file)
              stop = patch.find('\ndiff --git ', idx + len(name))
              return patch[idx:stop if stop > 0 else None]


          def expect_tokens(text, tokens, label):
              for token in tokens:
                  require(token in text, label + '_MISSING_TOKEN:' + token)


          def function_segment(source, start_token, end_token):
              start = source.find(start_token)
              require(start >= 0, 'LEGACY_FUNCTION_MISSING:' + start_token)
              end = source.find(end_token, start + len(start_token))
              require(end > start, 'LEGACY_FUNCTION_BOUNDARY_MISSING:' + start_token)
              return source[start:end]


          def review(p3, p4, r4_audit, r4_main, host_raw, ksu_raw, *, official_upstream=True):
              """Review fully pinned source inputs. Unit fixtures use official_upstream=False;
              production CLI never exposes a way to skip upstream Git blob identity."""
              if official_upstream:
                  require(blob_sha1(host_raw) == EXPECTED['susfs_host_git_blob'], 'SUSFS_510_HOST_BLOB_MISMATCH')
                  require(blob_sha1(ksu_raw) == EXPECTED['susfs_ksu_git_blob'], 'SUSFS_510_BAKASU_BLOB_MISMATCH')
              host = host_raw.decode('utf-8')
              ksu = ksu_raw.decode('utf-8')
              h = section(host, 'security/selinux/hooks.c')
              fs = section(host, 'security/selinux/selinuxfs.c')
              k = section(ksu, 'kernel/feature/selinux_hide.c')

              expect_tokens(h, ['+extern struct selinux_state fake_state;', '+extern bool ksu_selinux_hide_running',
                                'bool should_check_current', 'security_context_to_sid(&fake_state',
                                'security_context_to_sid(&selinux_state'], 'UPSTREAM_SETPROCATTR')
              expect_tokens(fs, ['sel_open_handle_status', 'current_uid().val >= 10000',
                                 'ksu_selinux_hide_running', 'mutex_lock(&selinux_state.status_lock)',
                                 'filp->private_data = data;', 'initialize_fake_status();',
                                 'sel_write_context', 'security_context_to_sid(&fake_state',
                                 'security_sid_to_context(&fake_state', 'sel_write_access',
                                 'security_context_str_to_sid(&fake_state',
                                 'security_compute_av_user(&fake_state'], 'UPSTREAM_SELINUXFS')
              require(fs.count('security_context_str_to_sid(&fake_state') == 2,
                      'UPSTREAM_SELINUXFS_TWO_CONTEXT_SIDS_REQUIRED')
              expect_tokens(k, ['+struct selinux_state fake_state;',
                                '-static int my_sel_open_handle_status',
                                '-struct ksu_lsm_hook selinux_setprocattr_hook',
                                '+void ksu_selinux_hide_handle_second_stage()',
                                'fake_status_initialize_key'], 'UPSTREAM_BAKASU_ARCHITECTURE')

              manifest = load_json(take(p3, 'SOURCE_AUDIT_P3.json'), 'P3')
              p4report = load_json(take(p4, 'P4_SOURCE_GATE.json'), 'P4')
              parity = load_json(take(r4_audit, 'veux-r5s2-work/report/SUSFS_BAKASU_54_PARITY_8175.json'), 'R4_PARITY')
              build = load_json(take(r4_audit, 'veux-r5s2-work/builds/diagnostics/5.4.274/RESULT.json'), 'R4_RESULT')
              require(manifest.get('git_commit') == P3 and manifest.get('r4_known_good_commit') == R4,
                      'P3_PROVENANCE_DRIFT')
              require(manifest.get('source_origin') == 'PREFLIGHT_NOT_FINAL_BUILD' and
                      manifest.get('kernel_compiled') is False and manifest.get('kernel') == '5.4.274',
                      'P3_ORIGIN_NOT_PREFLIGHT')
              require(p4report.get('r4_commit') == R4 and p4report.get('p3_commit') == P3 and
                      p4report.get('compiled_bakasu_sha256') == EXPECTED['r4_bakasu'] and
                      p4report.get('susfs_510_comparison_head') == SUSFS510 and
                      p4report.get('decision') == 'NOT_READY_FOR_FINAL_BUILD' and
                      p4report.get('flash_approved') is False,
                      'P4_PIN_OR_SAFETY_STATE_DRIFT')
              require(p4report.get('final_composed_selinux_3_files_proven') is True and
                      p4report.get('mount_clone_mnt') == 'ALREADY_CORRECT',
                      'P4_SOURCE_PROOFS_MISSING')
              require(parity.get('result') == 'SOURCE_PARITY_PASS_DEVICE_UNTESTED' and
                      isinstance(parity.get('checks'), list) and
                      len(parity['checks']) >= 14 and
                      all(c.get('result') == 'PASS' for c in parity['checks']),
                      'R4_PARITY_NOT_ALL_PASS')
              require(build.get('kernel') == '5.4.274' and
                      all(build.get(m) is True for m in ('compile', 'package', 'static_boot')) and
                      build.get('device') is False,
                      'R4_COMPILED_REFERENCE_NOT_PROVEN')
              compiled = take(r4_main, 'evidence/BAKASU_R5S1_COMPILED_SELINUX_REFERENCE.c', EXPECTED['r4_bakasu']).decode()
              preflight = take(p3, 'kernel/KernelSU/kernel/feature/selinux_hide.c', EXPECTED['p3_bakasu']).decode()
              host_hooks = take(p3, 'kernel/security/selinux/hooks.c', EXPECTED['p3_hooks']).decode()
              host_selinuxfs = take(p3, 'kernel/security/selinux/selinuxfs.c', EXPECTED['p3_selinuxfs']).decode()
              namespace = take(p3, 'kernel/fs/namespace.c', EXPECTED['p3_namespace']).decode()
              require('static struct selinux_state fake_state;' not in host_hooks and
                      'extern struct selinux_state fake_state;' not in host_hooks and
                      'extern struct selinux_state fake_state;' not in host_selinuxfs and
                      'fake_status_initialize_key' not in host_selinuxfs,
                      'DUPLICATE_NATIVE_510_HOST_HOOKS')
              require('is_mnt_ksu_unshared' in namespace and 'CL_COPY_MNT_NS' in namespace,
                      'CLONEMNT_MISSING')
              require(compiled != preflight and sha256(compiled.encode()) != sha256(preflight.encode()),
                      'PREFLIGHT_FALSELY_IDENTICAL_TO_COMPILED')
              expect_tokens(compiled, [
                  '#if LINUX_VERSION_CODE < KERNEL_VERSION(5, 10, 0)',
                  '#error BakaSU does NOT support susfs selinux_hide feature in nongki',
                  'static ssize_t my_write_context', 'static ssize_t my_write_access',
                  'static int my_sel_open_handle_status',
                  'ksu_handle_selinux_setprocattr', 'ksu_selinux_hide_unhook', 'ksu_patch_text',
              ], 'LEGACY_R4')
              ctx = function_segment(compiled, 'static ssize_t my_write_context', 'static ssize_t my_write_access')
              acc = function_segment(compiled, 'static ssize_t my_write_access', 'static inline u32 cred_sid')
              proc = function_segment(compiled, 'int __nocfi ksu_handle_selinux_setprocattr', 'static int my_sel_open_handle_status')
              status = function_segment(compiled, 'static int my_sel_open_handle_status', 'static void hook_selinux_status_open')
              expect_tokens(ctx, ['< 10000 || !ksu_selinux_hide_running', 'orig_context_write(',
                                  'ksu_security_context_to_sid(', 'ksu_security_sid_to_context('], 'CONTEXT_LEGACY')
              expect_tokens(acc, ['< 10000 || !ksu_selinux_hide_running', 'orig_access_write(',
                                  'ksu_security_context_to_sid(', 'ksu_security_compute_av_user(',
                                  'avd.seqno = 1;'], 'ACCESS_LEGACY')
              expect_tokens(proc, ['< 10000 || !ksu_selinux_hide_running', 'if (strcmp(name, "current"))',
                                   'if (error2 || error)', 'prepare_creds()', 'commit_creds(new)',
                                   'call_orig:', 'ksu_orig_setprocattr'], 'SETPROCATTR_LEGACY')
              expect_tokens(status, ['>= 10000 && ksu_selinux_hide_running', 'mutex_lock(ksu_selinux_status_lock)',
                                     'filp->private_data = data;', 'orig_sel_open_handle_status(',
                                     'initialize_fake_status();'], 'STATUS_LEGACY')

              cases = [
                  {'feature':'selinux_status', 'legacy':'my_sel_open_handle_status', 'native':'sel_open_handle_status',
                   'source_result':'SAME_UID_RUNNING_INTENT_DIFFERENT_HOOK_AND_LOCK_LIFECYCLE',
                   'runtime_parity_proven':False},
                  {'feature':'context_check', 'legacy':'my_write_context', 'native':'sel_write_context',
                   'source_result':'SAME_UID_RUNNING_INTENT_DIFFERENT_POLICY_API_AND_REDIRECT',
                   'runtime_parity_proven':False},
                  {'feature':'access_compute', 'legacy':'my_write_access', 'native':'sel_write_access',
                   'source_result':'LEGACY_FORCES_AVD_SEQNO_1_NATIVE_USES_FAKE_POLICY_RESULT',
                   'runtime_parity_proven':False},
                  {'feature':'setprocattr', 'legacy':'ksu_handle_selinux_setprocattr', 'native':'selinux_setprocattr',
                   'source_result':'LEGACY_INTERCEPT_AND_CRED_COMMIT_NATIVE_FAKE_SID_PRECHECK_PLUS_STOCK_PATH',
                   'runtime_parity_proven':False},
                  {'feature':'hook_lifecycle', 'legacy':'ksu_patch_text + ksu_selinux_hide_unhook',
                   'native':'direct SUSFS SELinux hooks and fake_state',
                   'source_result':'DIFFERENT_INSTALL_UNINSTALL_PATHS; DUPLICATE_HOOKS_MUST_NOT_BE_COMBINED',
                   'runtime_parity_proven':False},
              ]
              return {
                  'schema': 1, 'mode':'P5_SOURCE_FUNCTIONAL_INTENT_ONLY',
                  'result':'SOURCE_FUNCTIONAL_DELTA_MAPPED_WITH_UNPROVEN_RUNTIME_PARITY',
                  'kernel':'5.4.274', 'bakasu':'35234', 'nomount_dev':'8175c9dc',
                  'susfs_core_pin':'5326e21a7eb232f9e21debdd5164e99bee3d1e2f',
                  'susfs_510_head':SUSFS510, 'r4_commit':R4, 'p3_commit':P3,
                  'p4_known_identity_pass':True,
                  'r4_compiled_selinux_sha256':EXPECTED['r4_bakasu'],
                  'preflight_is_not_final_assembled_kernel':True,
                  'native_510_patch_applied':False,
                  'source_changes':False, 'brene_changed':False, 'build_triggered':False,
                  'device_tested':False, 'final_build_approved':False, 'flash_approved':False,
                  'functional_equivalence_proven':False,
                  'differential_observations':cases,
                  'decision':'RETAIN_WORKING_5_4_BACKEND; MANUAL_RUNTIME_OR_EMULATED_BEHAVIOR_PROOFS_REQUIRED_BEFORE_PORT',
                  'next':'Run isolated, bounded behavior-model tests for SELinux status, context, access and setprocattr error paths; do not combine native 5.10 and legacy 5.4 hooks without implementation-specific proof.'
              }


          def main(argv=None):
              ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
              for arg in ('p3-zip','p4-zip','r4-audit-zip','r4-main-zip','susfs-host-patch','susfs-ksu-patch','output'):
                  ap.add_argument('--'+arg,required=True,type=Path)
              ns=ap.parse_args(argv)
              try:
                  with read_archive(ns.p3_zip, EXPECTED['p3_zip'], 'P3') as p3, \
                       read_archive(ns.p4_zip, EXPECTED['p4_zip'], 'P4') as p4, \
                       read_archive(ns.r4_audit_zip, EXPECTED['r4_audit_zip'], 'R4_AUDIT') as audit, \
                       read_archive(ns.r4_main_zip, EXPECTED['r4_main_zip'], 'R4_MAIN') as mainzip:
                      result=review(p3,p4,audit,mainzip,
                                    Path(ns.susfs_host_patch).read_bytes(),
                                    Path(ns.susfs_ksu_patch).read_bytes())
                  ns.output.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
                  ns.output.write_text(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
                  print('P5_READ_ONLY_FUNCTIONAL_SOURCE_AUDIT=PASS; 5_DIFFERENCES=DOCUMENTED; '
                        'KERNEL_BUILD=NO; RUNTIME_PARITY=UNPROVEN; FINAL_BUILD=BLOCKED; NO_FLASH=YES')
                  return 0
              except (GateBlocked, OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile, UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
                  print('P5_SOURCE_AUDIT_BLOCKED:'+str(exc),file=sys.stderr)
                  return 1


          if __name__ == '__main__':
              raise SystemExit(main())
          PY_P5_GATE
          cat > "$P5_WORK/checks/test_p5_source_audit.py" <<'PY_P5_TESTS'
          #!/usr/bin/env python3
          """P5 tests use real R4/P3/P4 ZIPs plus synthetic 5.10 patch excerpts.
          Production CLI separately enforces exact upstream Git blob identities.
          """
          import io
          import json
          import os
          import sys
          import tempfile
          import unittest
          import zipfile
          from pathlib import Path
          from unittest.mock import patch

          sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
          import p5_source_audit as gate

          HOST_FIXTURE = r'''diff --git a/security/selinux/hooks.c b/security/selinux/hooks.c
          @@ -10,2 +10,5 @@
          +extern struct selinux_state fake_state;
          +extern bool ksu_selinux_hide_running __read_mostly;
          +bool should_check_current = (likely(!strcmp(name, "current") && current_uid().val >= 10000 && ksu_selinux_hide_running));
          +int fake_error = security_context_to_sid(&fake_state, value, size, &tmp_sid, GFP_KERNEL);
           error = security_context_to_sid(&selinux_state, value, size, &sid, GFP_KERNEL);
          diff --git a/security/selinux/selinuxfs.c b/security/selinux/selinuxfs.c
          @@ -30,2 +30,8 @@
           static int sel_open_handle_status(struct inode *inode, struct file *filp)
          +if (likely(current_uid().val >= 10000 && ksu_selinux_hide_running)) {
          +  mutex_lock(&selinux_state.status_lock);
          +  filp->private_data = data;
          +}
          +if (!fake_status) initialize_fake_status();
           static ssize_t sel_write_context(struct file *file, char *buf, size_t size)
          +length = security_context_to_sid(&fake_state, buf, size, &sid, GFP_KERNEL);
          +length = security_sid_to_context(&fake_state, sid, &canon, &len);
           static ssize_t sel_write_access(struct file *file, char *buf, size_t size)
          +length = security_context_str_to_sid(&fake_state, scon, &ssid, GFP_KERNEL);
          +length = security_context_str_to_sid(&fake_state, tcon, &tsid, GFP_KERNEL);
          +security_compute_av_user(&fake_state, ssid, tsid, tclass, &avd);
          '''.encode()
          KSU_FIXTURE = r'''diff --git a/kernel/feature/selinux_hide.c b/kernel/feature/selinux_hide.c
          @@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
          +struct selinux_state fake_state;
          -static int my_sel_open_handle_status(struct inode *inode, struct file *filp)
          -struct ksu_lsm_hook selinux_setprocattr_hook
          +void ksu_selinux_hide_handle_second_stage()
          +static_key_disable(&fake_status_initialize_key.key);
          '''.encode()


          def rewrite(z, changes):
              buf=io.BytesIO()
              with zipfile.ZipFile(buf,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as t:
                  for p in z.namelist():
                      t.writestr(p,changes.get(p,z.read(p)))
              buf.seek(0)
              return zipfile.ZipFile(buf)


          class P5Tests(unittest.TestCase):
              @classmethod
              def setUpClass(cls):
                  root=Path(os.environ.get('VEUX_P5_FIXTURES','/mnt/data'))
                  cls.root=root
                  cls.p3=zipfile.ZipFile(root/'VEUX_SUSFS54_P3_RUN39225149753_ORIGINAL.zip')
                  cls.p4=zipfile.ZipFile(root/'VEUX_SUSFS54_P4_RUN39232161365_AUDIT.zip')
                  cls.audit=zipfile.ZipFile(root/'VEUX_R4_12167285024.zip')
                  cls.main=zipfile.ZipFile(root/'VEUX_NOMOUNT_DEV_8175_R4_MAIN.zip')

              @classmethod
              def tearDownClass(cls):
                  for x in (cls.p3,cls.p4,cls.audit,cls.main):x.close()

              def review(self, p3=None,p4=None,audit=None,main=None,host=None,ksu=None):
                  return gate.review(p3 or self.p3,p4 or self.p4,audit or self.audit,
                      main or self.main,HOST_FIXTURE if host is None else host,
                      KSU_FIXTURE if ksu is None else ksu,official_upstream=False)

              def check_blocked(self,needle,**changes):
                  with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateBlocked,needle):
                      self.review(**changes)

              def test_01_genuine_r4_p3_p4_sources_source_review_passes(self):
                  report=self.review()
                  self.assertEqual(report['result'],'SOURCE_FUNCTIONAL_DELTA_MAPPED_WITH_UNPROVEN_RUNTIME_PARITY')
                  self.assertEqual(len(report['differential_observations']),5)
                  self.assertFalse(report['functional_equivalence_proven'])
                  self.assertFalse(report['final_build_approved'])
                  self.assertFalse(report['source_changes'])

              def test_02_explicit_sequence_number_difference(self):
                  self.assertIn('AVD_SEQNO_1',self.review()['differential_observations'][2]['source_result'])

              def test_03_reject_modified_p3_hooks(self):
                  f='kernel/security/selinux/hooks.c'
                  with rewrite(self.p3,{f:self.p3.read(f)+b'\n/* stray write */'}) as z:
                      self.check_blocked('SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH',p3=z)

              def test_04_reject_modified_p3_selinuxfs(self):
                  f='kernel/security/selinux/selinuxfs.c'
                  with rewrite(self.p3,{f:self.p3.read(f)+b'\n/* new hook */'}) as z:
                      self.check_blocked('SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH',p3=z)

              def test_05_reject_false_p3_provenance(self):
                  f='SOURCE_AUDIT_P3.json'; j=json.loads(self.p3.read(f));j['git_commit']='0'*40
                  with rewrite(self.p3,{f:json.dumps(j).encode()}) as z:
                      self.check_blocked('P3_PROVENANCE_DRIFT',p3=z)

              def test_06_reject_false_p4_decision(self):
                  f='P4_SOURCE_GATE.json';j=json.loads(self.p4.read(f));j['decision']='READY_FOR_FINAL_BUILD'
                  with rewrite(self.p4,{f:json.dumps(j).encode()}) as z:
                      self.check_blocked('P4_PIN_OR_SAFETY_STATE_DRIFT',p4=z)

              def test_07_reject_r4_bakasu_modified_bytes(self):
                  f='evidence/BAKASU_R5S1_COMPILED_SELINUX_REFERENCE.c'
                  with rewrite(self.main,{f:self.main.read(f).replace(b'ksu_selinux_hide_running',b'ksu_selinux_hide_enabl_d')}) as z:
                      self.check_blocked('SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH',main=z)

              def test_08_reject_missing_r4_audit_proof(self):
                  f='veux-r5s2-work/report/SUSFS_BAKASU_54_PARITY_8175.json'
                  with rewrite(self.audit,{f:json.dumps({'result':'FAIL'}).encode()}) as z:
                      self.check_blocked('R4_PARITY_NOT_ALL_PASS',audit=z)

              def test_09_reject_wrong_5_10_host_semantics(self):
                  self.check_blocked('UPSTREAM_SELINUXFS_MISSING_TOKEN',host=HOST_FIXTURE.replace(b'initialize_fake_status();',b'initialize_later();'))

              def test_10_reject_missing_sid_conversion(self):
                  self.check_blocked('UPSTREAM_SELINUXFS_TWO_CONTEXT_SIDS_REQUIRED',host=HOST_FIXTURE.replace(
                      b'security_context_str_to_sid(&fake_state, tcon',b'security_context_str_to_sid(&selinux_state, tcon'))

              def test_11_reject_5_10_upstream_ksu_hook_collision_contract(self):
                  self.check_blocked('UPSTREAM_BAKASU_ARCHITECTURE_MISSING_TOKEN',ksu=KSU_FIXTURE.replace(
                      b'-static int my_sel_open_handle_status',b'+static int my_sel_open_handle_status'))

              def test_12_upstream_git_blob_pin_enforced(self):
                  with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateBlocked,'SUSFS_510_HOST_BLOB_MISMATCH'):
                      gate.review(self.p3,self.p4,self.audit,self.main,HOST_FIXTURE,KSU_FIXTURE)

              def test_13_reject_wrong_p4_source_proof(self):
                  f='P4_SOURCE_GATE.json';j=json.loads(self.p4.read(f));j['mount_clone_mnt']='PATCH_REQUIRED'
                  with rewrite(self.p4,{f:json.dumps(j).encode()}) as z:
                      self.check_blocked('P4_SOURCE_PROOFS_MISSING',p4=z)

              def test_14_reject_no_actual_r4_compile(self):
                  f='veux-r5s2-work/builds/diagnostics/5.4.274/RESULT.json'
                  j=json.loads(self.audit.read(f));j['compile']=False
                  with rewrite(self.audit,{f:json.dumps(j).encode()}) as z:
                      self.check_blocked('R4_COMPILED_REFERENCE_NOT_PROVEN',audit=z)

              def test_15_reject_source_masked_duplicate_native_hooks(self):
                  f='kernel/security/selinux/hooks.c'
                  bad=self.p3.read(f)+b'\nextern struct selinux_state fake_state;\n'
                  # Pin check must catch the mutation before duplicate-native logic.
                  with rewrite(self.p3,{f:bad}) as z:
                      self.check_blocked('SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH',p3=z)

              def test_16_read_only_zip_inputs_after_review(self):
                  paths=[self.root/n for n in ('VEUX_SUSFS54_P3_RUN39225149753_ORIGINAL.zip','VEUX_SUSFS54_P4_RUN39232161365_AUDIT.zip','VEUX_R4_12167285024.zip','VEUX_NOMOUNT_DEV_8175_R4_MAIN.zip')]
                  before=[gate.sha256(p.read_bytes()) for p in paths]
                  self.review()
                  self.assertEqual(before,[gate.sha256(p.read_bytes()) for p in paths])

              def test_17_reject_unknown_zip_sha_even_when_zip_valid(self):
                  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t:
                      p=Path(t)/'wrong.zip'
                      p.write_bytes((self.root/'VEUX_SUSFS54_P3_RUN39225149753_ORIGINAL.zip').read_bytes()+b'X')
                      with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.GateBlocked,'P3_SHA256_MISMATCH'):
                          gate.read_archive(p,gate.EXPECTED['p3_zip'],'P3')

              def test_18_upstream_pins_are_git_blob_sha1_not_partial_hash(self):
                  self.assertEqual(len(gate.EXPECTED['susfs_host_git_blob']),40)
                  self.assertEqual(len(gate.EXPECTED['susfs_ksu_git_blob']),40)
                  self.assertEqual(gate.blob_sha1(b'abc'), 'f2ba8f84ab5c1bce84a7b441cb1959cfc7093b7f')


          if __name__=='__main__':
              unittest.main()
          PY_P5_TESTS
          printf '%s  %s\n' '2b3bee234ea600aa73e0860a715ffbb0bdf9ec271798e1f3e3267ca5ba6cda90' "$P5_WORK/checks/p5_source_audit.py" | sha256sum --check --status
          printf '%s  %s\n' '69c115045fe4c0d7061a3f4ca062d56861a55668a6d2fe5c3410f727f7a8b8b7' "$P5_WORK/checks/test_p5_source_audit.py" | sha256sum --check --status
          python3 -m py_compile "$P5_WORK/checks/p5_source_audit.py" "$P5_WORK/checks/test_p5_source_audit.py"
          echo 'P5_EMBEDDED_CHECKER_TESTS_HASH_AND_AST=PASS'
      - name: Run P5 functional source audit and controlled negative tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cp "$P5_WORK/archives/p3.zip" "$P5_WORK/fixtures/VEUX_SUSFS54_P3_RUN39225149753_ORIGINAL.zip"
          cp "$P5_WORK/archives/p4.zip" "$P5_WORK/fixtures/VEUX_SUSFS54_P4_RUN39232161365_AUDIT.zip"

          cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/VEUX_NOMOUNT_DEV_8175_R4_MAIN.zip" "$P5_WORK/fixtures/VEUX_NOMOUNT_DEV_8175_R4_MAIN.zip"
          python3 "$P5_WORK/checks/p5_source_audit.py" \
            --p3-zip "$P5_WORK/archives/p3.zip" \
            --p4-zip "$P5_WORK/archives/p4.zip" \
            --r4-audit-zip "$P5_WORK/archives/r4_audit.zip" \
            --r4-main-zip "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/VEUX_NOMOUNT_DEV_8175_R4_MAIN.zip" \
            --susfs-host-patch "$P5_WORK/upstream/host.patch" \
            --susfs-ksu-patch "$P5_WORK/upstream/ksu.patch" \
            --output "$P5_WORK/reports/P5_FUNCTIONAL_SOURCE_AUDIT.json"
          VEUX_P5_FIXTURES="$P5_WORK/fixtures" python3 -m unittest discover \
            -s "$P5_WORK/checks" -p test_p5_source_audit.py -v \
            > "$P5_WORK/reports/P5_TESTS.log" 2>&1 || { cat "$P5_WORK/reports/P5_TESTS.log"; exit 1; }
          cat "$P5_WORK/reports/P5_TESTS.log"
          python3 - <<'PY_P5_SUMMARY'
          import json,os
          from pathlib import Path
          root=Path(os.environ['P5_WORK'])/'reports'
          report=json.loads((root/'P5_FUNCTIONAL_SOURCE_AUDIT.json').read_text())
          log=(root/'P5_TESTS.log').read_text()
          if ('Ran 18 tests' not in log or '\nOK\n' not in log or 'skipped' in log.lower() or
              len(report['differential_observations'])!=5 or report['final_build_approved'] is not False or
              report['functional_equivalence_proven'] is not False or report['source_changes'] is not False):
              raise SystemExit('P5_NO_BUILD_AND_18_TESTS_GATE_FAILED')
          lines=['# VEUX SUSFS 5.4 P5 – funktionaler Quellenvergleich','',
                 'Source-only; kein Kernel-Build, kein Flash.','',
                 '| Bereich | Befund |','|---|---|']
          for row in report['differential_observations']:
              lines.append('| '+row['feature']+' | '+row['source_result'].replace('_',' ')+' |')
          lines+=['', '**Bewertung:** Runtime-Paritaet NICHT nachgewiesen; native 5.10-Hooks NICHT integrieren.',
                  '', 'R4 5.4.274 + BakaSU 35234 + SUSFS 2.3 + NoMount 8175 bleibt unveraendert.',
                  '', 'P5-Testprotokoll: 18/18 PASS; alle Quell- und Upstream-Pins sind geprueft.']
          (root/'P5_BERICHT_DE.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
          print('P5_5_FUNCTIONAL_DIFFERENCES_AND_18_HOST_TESTS=PASS; RUNTIME_PARITY=UNPROVEN')
          PY_P5_SUMMARY
      - name: Independently ShellCheck all P5 YAML bash run blocks
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY_P5_SC'
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess
          path=Path('.github/workflows/VEUX_SUSFS54_P5_FUNCTIONAL_SOURCE_AUDIT_NO_BUILD.yml')
          lines=path.read_text().splitlines()
          blocks=[];i=0
          while i<len(lines):
              if lines[i]=='        run: |':
                  i+=1;block=[]
                  while i<len(lines) and (lines[i].startswith('          ') or lines[i]==''):
                      block.append(lines[i][10:] if lines[i].startswith('          ') else '')
                      i+=1
                  blocks.append('\n'.join(block)+'\n')
              else:
                  i+=1
          if len(blocks)!=8:
              raise SystemExit('P5_SHELLCHECK_RUN_BLOCK_COUNT_DRIFT:'+str(len(blocks)))
          for n,script in enumerate(blocks,1):
              p=subprocess.run(['shellcheck','--severity=warning','--shell=bash','-'],input=script,text=True,capture_output=True)
              if p.returncode:
                  print(p.stdout,p.stderr)
                  raise SystemExit('P5_SHELLCHECK_FAILED_RUN_BLOCK_'+str(n))
          print('P5_INDEPENDENT_SHELLCHECK=PASS; BLOCKS='+str(len(blocks)))
          PY_P5_SC
      - name: Upload P5 read-only source audit, even if blocked
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: VEUX-SUSFS54-P5-READONLY-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ env.P5_WORK }}/reports/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 6
      - name: Assert repository unchanged and never build or flash

        run: |

          test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = "$EXPECTED_REPO"

          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
          echo 'P5_REPOSITORY_UNCHANGED=YES; BUILD=NO; FLASH=NO; FINAL_BUILD=BLOCKED'
